name: lucarne-corpus-mcp
description: Optional thin stdio MCP bin: read-only queries over a lucarne-records store. Never fetches, replays, or opens a browser — a miss returns a structured not_captured result telling the agent to browse to it in-session.
author: Aaron Volter

scripts.test: npm run build && node test/config.mjs && node test/queries.mjs && node test/no-egress.mjs && node test/mcp-tools.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node test/config.mjs && node test/queries.mjs && node test/no-egress.mjs && node test/mcp-tools.mjs && node test/package-clean-gate.mjs
